description: This script manages Google Sheets updates based on build/test data, including parsing build info, generating formulas, and updating sheets with test results and filters.

methods.name: get_latest_success_build_info
methods.description: Retrieves info about the latest successful build for a given bot, including build name, link, timestamp, revisions.

methods.name: get_step_names
methods.description: Fetches step names starting with 'angle_' from a build.

methods.name: get_step_info
methods.description: Parses logs of a build step to extract test statistics and messages.

methods.name: validate_step_info
methods.description: Validates that the step info sums correctly if 'Total' is present.

methods.name: get_bot_info
methods.description: Gathers build info and step details for a specific bot.

methods.name: get_spreadsheet
methods.description: Fetches spreadsheet metadata from Google Sheets API.

methods.name: format_sheet_name
methods.description: Generates a formatted sheet name based on bot and step info.

methods.name: get_sheet_names
methods.description: Generates list of sheet names from build info.

methods.name: sheet_exists
methods.description: Checks if a sheet exists in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: validate_sheets
methods.description: Determines which sheets need to be created.

methods.name: batch_update
methods.description: Performs batch update requests to Google Sheets.

methods.name: create_sheets
methods.description: Creates new sheets in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Retrieves header row data from sheets.

methods.name: batch_update_values
methods.description: Updates cell values in sheets.

methods.name: get_sheet_id
methods.description: Gets the sheet ID for a given sheet name.

methods.name: update_filters
methods.description: Sets filters on sheets to hide duplicate rows.

methods.name: update_headers
methods.description: Ensures headers contain required columns and updates sheets if needed.

methods.name: append_values
methods.description: Appends a row of data to a sheet.

methods.name: generate_duplicate_formula
methods.description: Recursively generates a formula to identify duplicate rows based on specified columns.

methods.name: generate_duplicate_formula_helper
methods.description: Initializes duplicate formula generation based on main result columns.

methods.name: update_values
methods.description: Populates sheets with latest build/test data.

methods.name: update_spreadsheet
methods.description: Main function to update entire spreadsheet with build info.

methods.name: get_sheets_service
methods.description: Authenticates and creates a Google Sheets API service object.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments.

methods.name: initialize_logging
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration based on verbosity.
